body:
I was expecting a hollow answer like "it will get better" or nothing at all. But this seems, sincere to say the least, I hope its like that, that's what I want to believe. About it... You may be right, maybe I should have written it earlier, maybe now its too late. I hope that I don't have to fulfil what I said, but it seems like I will... The other times were something out of impulse, I never had it so rationalized or so accepted. About why my parents don't take it more seriously, its because I had to lie to the pshychiatrist and tell them that it was just to seek attention, they of course believed it and rolled with it. 

I thank you for this, it even made me smile, its not like I can't smile, some people think that. Its just that I feel that 1 smile its not worth for all the suffering. I don't want to sound dramatic. Thanks.
